subject: Thermal Paper & POS Supplies Available — Performance Supply Depot
body:
Hello,

I hope this email finds you well. My name is Miles with Performance Supply Depot LLC.

I'm reaching out because we specialize in restaurant POS supplies, including thermal paper rolls, receipt paper, and related equipment at competitive prices.

We currently have thermal paper in stock and ready to ship:
• 2 1/4" x 50' thermal rolls (standard credit card terminals)
• 3 1/8" x 230' thermal rolls (common POS systems)
• Bulk pricing available for multi-location operators
• Fast shipping nationwide

Would you be interested in receiving a quote for your location? We work with restaurants and franchises across the country and pride ourselves on reliability and quick turnaround.

If you're happy with your current supplier, no worries at all. Just wanted to introduce ourselves in case there's a fit.

Best regards,
Miles
Performance Supply Depot LLC
info@psdepot.com
https://psdepot.com
